title: Copilot and Autopilot are only offered when a sender on the Owner's Mac reads the outbox; without one, approving becomes Copy and send
description: Copilot says approved drafts go to your sending app and Autopilot hands finished drafts to it, but the Owner chose drafts only and has no sender installed (senders/email.mjs), so Approve drops a draft into an outbox that nothing reads and the dial promises something that does not happen. The sender writes a heartbeat at the end of every pass that loaded its settings: $FW_HOME/senders/email/last-pass.json { at, ok, sent }. A pass that cannot load its settings writes none. fwd reads it and reports sender { installed, last_pass_at } on GET /v1/status and at the top of GET /v1/supervisor; installed is true only when the last pass was in the last 24 hours, and last_pass_at is shown even when it is older. The hosted relay copies both answers as they are, so flowweb.app sees the same. fwd refuses a move to Copilot or Autopilot with no installed sender (409, the reason names the sender), from the CLI token, the paired browser and the site's queued flow.dial alike; Draft is always allowed. On the Flows page, with no installed sender, the Copilot and Autopilot stops are disabled with the reason 'Needs a sender on your Mac' and a link to the steps in senders/README.md, and a ready draft shows Copy and send instead of Approve: it copies the subject and text so the Owner sends it from his own mail, then marks it sent. With a sender installed everything is as before. Nothing here sends anything, adds a sender or widens what one may send; Resend is never used for outreach.
acceptance: A sender pass that loads its settings writes $FW_HOME/senders/email/last-pass.json with the time of the pass; a pass with no settings writes none
GET /v1/status and GET /v1/supervisor report sender { installed, last_pass_at }: not installed with no heartbeat or one older than 24 hours, installed with a fresh one
With no installed sender fwd answers 409 to a move to Copilot or Autopilot and the dial stays where it was; Draft is allowed; with a fresh heartbeat Copilot is allowed
On the Flows page with no installed sender the Copilot and Autopilot stops are disabled and say Needs a sender on your Mac with a link to the sender steps; with one they are enabled
With no installed sender a ready draft shows Copy and send, which copies its subject and text and approves nothing; with one it shows Approve
